classification.difficultyReason: Requires arranging nine distinct numbers under three interacting equal-sum constraints.

content.prompt: Place the numbers 1 to 9 in each of the circles in the following figure so that the sums of the numbers on each straight line are equal.

spec.description: Nine blank circles on a triangular perimeter: three vertices and two intermediate circles on each side. White interiors mask the connecting lines. Ordinary source blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: Each of the three straight sides contains four circles; adjacent sides share a vertex. There are no internal edges or interior circles.
spec.answerVisibility: All nine circle interiors are blank in the question.

answer.short: One solution is shown. Each side sums to $17$.
answer.worked:
Place $1$, $3$ and $2$ at the top, bottom-left and bottom-right vertices. Place $7,6$ down the left side, $5,9$ down the right side, and $4,8$ along the base from left to right.

Check the three sides:
$$\begin{align*}1+7+6+3&=17\\1+5+9+2&=17\\3+4+8+2&=17\end{align*}$$
Every number from $1$ to $9$ is used once. Other solutions are possible.

spec.description: Completed triangle with the same nine-circle topology as the question and one number in each circle.
spec.mathematics: Clockwise from the top: 1,5,9,2,8,4,3,6,7. Left, right and base sums are all 17.
